# Performance data

The numbers behind every chart on [Performance](performance.md), as tables. Each section gives the same numbers as the CSV file next to it, which you can download, and a source file that names the benchmark, the build, the date, the machine and the conditions, and the result file each number came from. The tables and the charts are generated from the CSV files by one script, so nothing here is typed by hand.

## How fresh the data is

Each data set comes from one BenchmarkDotNet run (or a few runs of the same build). The build is the commit of the benchmark project that was run; the date is when the run finished.

| Data | Charts | Build | Run date | Machine | Runtime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `synthetic-overhead.csv` | headline ratios, reader-open time, total time, memory | `b27a02f` | 2026-11-14 | AMD Ryzen 9 7900 3.70GHz, 1 CPU, 24 logical and 12 physical cores | .NET 11.0.0 (11.0.0, 11.0.26.53018), X64 RyuJIT x86-64-v4 |
| `width-sweep.csv` | cost grows with columns | `b27a02f` | 2026-11-14 | AMD Ryzen 9 7900 3.70GHz, 1 CPU, 24 logical and 12 physical cores | .NET 11.0.0 (11.0.0, 11.0.26.53018), X64 RyuJIT x86-64-v4 |
| `map-cost.csv` | what building a map costs | `544cc01` | 2026-11-14 | AMD Ryzen 9 7900 3.70GHz, 1 CPU, 24 logical and 12 physical cores | .NET 11.0.0 (11.0.0, 11.0.26.53018), X64 RyuJIT x86-64-v4 |

<a id="width"></a>
## Cost grows with the number of columns

[Back to the chart](performance.md#width). Total time per call (µs) at 1,000 rows. The last column is the cost of one more cell: the time at the widest result minus the time at the narrowest, divided by the cells added. Build b27a02f, 2026-11-14.

| Approach | 1 columns | 3 columns | 5 columns | 10 columns | 20 columns | Per added cell (ns) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Map(selector), hand-written | 10.7 | 11.9 | 16.8 | 31.2 | 47.0 | 1.91 |
| Map&lt;T&gt;(), the RowMap plan | 12.4 | 18.3 | 25.2 | 49.1 | 81.7 | 3.65 |
| Row class, inline Select | 28.3 | 32.4 | 41.4 | 67.2 | 106.7 | 4.12 |
| object[] rows (baseline) | 9.5 | 20.0 | 35.9 | 75.7 | 178.5 | 8.90 |
| Dapper Query&lt;T&gt; | 18.5 | 31.1 | 44.6 | 96.2 | 202.7 | 9.70 |

Data: [width-sweep.csv](../perf-data/width-sweep.csv) ([source and conditions](../perf-data/width-sweep.source.txt)).

<a id="map-cost"></a>
## What building a map costs

[Back to the chart](performance.md#map-cost). One row per call. The one-time cost is the time (and memory) of a call that builds and compiles a new map, minus a call that reuses the cached one. Build 544cc01, 2026-11-14.

| Columns | Reused map (µs) | Map built every call (ms) | One-time cost (ms) | Reused map (KB) | Built every call (KB) | One-time memory (KB) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 0.17 | 0.19 | 0.19 | 0.55 | 15.6 | 15.1 |
| 5 | 0.19 | 0.33 | 0.33 | 0.55 | 22.9 | 22.4 |
| 20 | 0.27 | 0.88 | 0.87 | 0.55 | 52.0 | 51.5 |

Data: [map-cost.csv](../perf-data/map-cost.csv) ([source and conditions](../perf-data/map-cost.source.txt)).

<a id="sync-async"></a>
## Sync reads against async reads

[Back to the chart](performance.md#sync-async). Reader-open time (µs), RowMap plan, 20 columns, 1,000 rows. Buffer refills: every 100 rows the reader waits 20 µs. Busy pool: 8 work items kept queued on the thread pool. Build ea5f096, 2026-11-14.

| Condition | Sync | Async execute | Async read | Async read against sync |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Neither | 77.3 µs | 80.9 µs | 82.3 µs | 1.07× |
| Busy thread pool | 94.4 µs | 97.4 µs | 102.4 µs | 1.08× |
| Buffer refills | 257.9 µs | 261.2 µs | 314.3 µs | 1.22× |
| Refills and busy pool | 279.3 µs | 279.0 µs | 11.2 ms | 40.01× |

Data: [sync-async.csv](../perf-data/sync-async.csv) ([source and conditions](../perf-data/sync-async.source.txt)).
